Professional Sofa Upholstery

Sofa Upholstery in Abu Dhabi

Looking for sofa upholstery in Abu Dhabi? K2 Curtains Shamka has over 16 years of experience fitting custom curtains, blinds, and home décor across the emirate. We bring fabric samples to your home, measure every window precisely, and install everything for a flawless finish.

Typical project range: AED 1,500 – AED 20,000

Breathe new life into your sofas with our professional upholstery service. We re-cover existing frames in velvet, leather, linen, or performance fabrics, replace worn foam and springs, and add decorative piping or tufting. Serving living rooms, majlis seating, dining chairs, and outdoor furniture across Abu Dhabi.

Our Sofa Upholstery Process

Every project follows a clear, proven process so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

1

On-Site Evaluation

We inspect your sofa frame, foam condition, and fabric wear at your home, then recommend fabric options and repair scope with a clear quote.

2

Fabric & Design Selection

Choose from hundreds of upholstery fabrics — velvet, leather, linen, chenille, and outdoor grades. Select colour, pattern, piping, and cushion style.

3

Stripping & Rebuilding

We strip old fabric, repair or replace webbing and springs, install new high-density foam, and cut and stitch the new cover to exact pattern.

4

Delivery & Placement

Your reupholstered sofa is delivered, positioned, and inspected at your home. We check fit, comfort, and finish before final handover.

Frequently Asked Questions About Sofa Upholstery

Do you offer free home measurement in Abu Dhabi?
Yes, we offer completely free home consultation and measurement throughout Abu Dhabi and surrounding areas. Our consultant brings fabric samples, measures your windows precisely, and provides a detailed quote with no obligation. Call +971 52 774 0358 to book your appointment.
How long does it take to make custom curtains?
Most custom curtain orders are ready within 7–14 days depending on fabric availability and complexity. For urgent requests, we offer an express service. Contact K2 Curtains Shamka on +971 52 774 0358 and we will confirm your timeline before you place the order.
What types of blinds do you supply in Abu Dhabi?
We supply and install Roman blinds, roller blinds, Venetian blinds, and motorized smart blinds across Abu Dhabi. Each blind is made to your exact window size with a choice of blackout, sunscreen, or translucent fabrics. Book a free consultation to see samples in your own home.
Can you install motorized curtains?
Absolutely. Our motorized curtain tracks integrate with Alexa, Google Home, and most smart home systems. We install silent motors, set up remote and voice control, and program schedules to suit your lifestyle. Call +971 52 774 0358 for a smart home curtain consultation.
Do you provide sofa upholstery services in Abu Dhabi?
Yes, we offer professional sofa reupholstery in Abu Dhabi. We strip old fabric, repair frames and foam, and recover your sofa in velvet, leather, linen, or performance fabric of your choice. We can also reupholster dining chairs, headboards, and Arabic majlis seating.
